lines.text: God is our refuge and strength, so we will not fear though mountains are toppled into the seas.
A river's streams bring delight to the city of God, and God will help her when the sun sets.
Nations rage and kingdoms crumble, and the LORD of Hosts is with us.
The LORD makes wars cease, breaking the bow, shattering the spear, and burning the chariots in the fire.
God says to be still and know that He is God, and He will be exalted among the nations.
